# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    T AS (
        SELECT
            user_id,
            DATEDIFF(
                LEAD(visit_date, 1, '2021-1-1') OVER (
                    PARTITION BY user_id
                    ORDER BY visit_date
                ),
                visit_date
            ) AS diff
        FROM UserVisits
    )
SELECT user_id, MAX(diff) AS biggest_window
FROM T
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
title: Biggest Window Between Visits
